newsitem.title: USA: Twenty First Century plans acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Twenty First Century plans acquisition.

text.p: Twenty First Century Health Inc on Friday said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Modern Tea Ball Service Inc and Tea & Spice Exclusively Ltd, based in Brooklyn, New York, for 225,000 common shares.
Shares of Twenty First Century last closed at 10-1/16 on February 7.
Twenty First Century said Naturally Scientific Inc, in which Twenty First Century has a controlling stake, will use Modern Tea Ball's facilities to produce its own brands of tea and botttled water.
In addition, the company on Thursday unveiled a new line of liquid colloidal nutritional supplements. The line contains 25 vitamins, minerals, extracts and hormones.
Twenty First Century Health Inc develops health related hygienic, home diagnostic, nutritional supplement and medical technology products.
